result.title: Machine Unlearning for Federated Socially Fair k-Means Clustering
result.comment: 53 pages, 7 figures, including appendices. The first three authors contributed equally. Supplementary code, data and scoped Lean proofs (v1.0.0): https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc/releases/tag/v1.0.0
result.summary: Federated clustering can support applications such as patient stratification across hospitals and customer segmentation across distributed financial datasets. Responsible AI calls for fair representation of demographic groups and support for data deletion, motivated in part by rights such as the GDPR's right to erasure. These goals interact: deleting records can change the balance between groups and alter the clustering of the remaining population. We study exact machine unlearning for federated socially fair $k$-means, whose objective is to minimize the largest group-average squared distance to the nearest center. Our approach keeps separate local summaries for each group, so summaries at unaffected institutions remain valid as global fairness weights change. For two groups, we prove an initialization approximation guarantee independent of client group proportions under ideal sampling, and we show that same-seed replay reproduces retraining exactly. Reuse pays off most when a whole client withdraws: across three datasets, replay is $35.8\times$ faster than retraining for the initialization-only model and remains $2.4\times$ and $1.7\times$ faster with one and two fair-refinement rounds, which improve worst-group cost. For individual record deletions, gains are modest (about $1.06\times$), and certifying cached assignments can cost more than it saves. These results map where exact unlearning can profitably reuse computation. Code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc.

AI.brief_summary: 研究联邦社会公平 k-means 的精确机器遗忘：为每个群体保留独立本地摘要，使未受影响客户端的摘要在全球公平权重变化后仍可复用，从而在客户端退出或记录删除时避免完整重训练，并在三个数据集上测量重放相对重训练的加速比。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「缓存中间状态在全局参数变化后是否仍有效、复用与重新认证的成本权衡（认证券化分配可能比省下的更贵）」可能类比 latent reasoning 中跨步状态缓存与复用的取舍，可供核查；但主体是联邦聚类与公平性，与视觉多模态推理联系较远。
